title: Herbal Hearty Turkish Cheese Flatbread
description: A fragrant herbal flatbread with melted cheese and spa-like aromatics, perfect for a hangover fix.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Add the warm water and olive oil, then stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm spot for 45 minutes until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough, divide it into four equal portions, and roll each into a thin circle about 12 inches in diameter.
Heat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering, then place a dough circle in the pan and cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden brown.
While the flatbread is cooking, combine the shredded cheese, chopped mint, chopped parsley, minced garlic, turmeric, and oregano in a small bowl.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the cooked flatbread, then fold the flatbread over and press the edges to seal; cook for an additional minute on each side until the cheese melts.
Repeat steps five through eight with the remaining dough portions.
Let the finished flatbreads cool for a few minutes, then slice into wedges and serve warm.
